body.name: Bonferroni exact causal projection
body.construction: Set \(\delta=\alpha/M_{\mathrm{total}}\), form every closed Clopper--Pearson interval \(I_{sj}(\delta)\), intersect their product with normalized \(\eta\)-positive randomized tables to obtain \(\mathcal C_n^P\), and project \(\{(p,g):p\in\mathcal C_n^P,\ A_p g=b_p\}\) through \((p,g)\mapsto R_p g\), where \(A_p,b_p,R_p\) are evaluated at the same candidate table \(p\).
